CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
June 24, 2025 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION: Rabbi Len Muroff, Temple Beth Ohr
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Friends of the La Mirada Theatre
4.

Councilmember Bean
Councilmember De Ruse
Councilmember Lewis
Mayor Pro Tem Otero
Mayor Eng
5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
PRESENTATION OF A COMMUNITY SPOTLIGHT AWARD - It is recommended the City Council present Lexi Santos with a Community Spotlight Award.
5.1 Community Spotlight Award
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT: (Any information or materials provided during Public Comments are recorded in the minutes and are subject to public disclosure under the Public Records Act. The speaker is requested, but is not required, to orally state his or her name and/or address for purposes of recording the information accurately in the minutes. If the speaker declines to provide his or her name, address, and other relevant information, the records will so indicate. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council.)
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of June 10, 2025 and the minutes of the regular meeting of June 10, 2025.
7.1 Minutes of 6-10-25 SS
7.1 Minutes of 6-10-25 CC
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated June 24, 2025 in the total amount of $2,678,978.40.
7.2 Warrant Register
7.3
PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH LEAD TECH ENVIRONMENTAL - It is recommended the City Council accept the proposal from Lead Tech Environmental to provide lead-based paint and asbestos inspection services; instruct the City Attorney to prepare the Professional Services Agreement; and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement with Lead Tech Environmental for lead-based paint and asbestos inspection services on behalf of the City.
7.3 Agreement with Lead Tech Environmental
7.4
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING MAY 2025 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending May 2025.
7.4 Investment Report
7.5
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING APRIL 2025 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending April 2025.
7.5 Monthly Treasurer Report
7.6
ANNUAL REPORT OF THE LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS FOUNDATION - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the Annual Report of the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts Foundation.
7.6 La Mirada Theatre Foundation Annual Report
7.7
STATUS UPDATE ON VACANCIES OF FULL-TIME POSITIONS IN COMPLIANCE WITH ASSEMBLY BILL 2561 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the status update on staff vacancies of full-time positions in compliance with Assembly Bill 2561 for Fiscal Year 2024-25.
7.7 Status Update of Vacancies
7.8
APPROVAL OF AN AGREEMENT WITH SANDLER PARTNERS/GOTO FOR A UNIFIED COMMUNICATIONS SYSTEM - It is recommended the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute an agreement with Sandler Partners/GoTo for a unified communications system.
7.8 Agreement with Sandler Partners - GoTo
7.9
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2023-07, NEIGHBORHOOD SLURRY SEAL AREA 5 – ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by All American Asphalt; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the contract.
7.9 CIP No. 2023-07
8.
PUBLIC HEARING
8.1
FIRST READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 743 DESIGNATING FIRE HAZARD SEVERITY ZONES - It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing and accept for first reading Ordinance No. 743 designating Fire Hazard Severity Zones, by title only, and waive further reading.
8.1 Ord. No. 743 - 1st Reading
8.2
RESOLUTION NO. 25-09 ADOPTING THE PROPOSED FISCAL YEAR 2025-26 BUDGET - It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing as prescribed by law and adopt Resolution No. 25-09 approving the Proposed Fiscal Year 2025-26 Budget.
8.2 Reso. No. 25-09
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 25-10 ESTABLISHING THE APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025-26 - It is recommended the City Council select the percentage change in the California Per Capita Personal Income as the inflation factor for Fiscal Year 2025-26; select the growth of the Couty as the population factor for Fiscal Year 2025-26; and adopt Resolution No. 25-10 establishing an Appropriations Limit for Fiscal Year 2025-26 pursuant to Article XIIIB of the California Constitution.
Reso. No. 25-10
9.2
RESOLUTION NO. 25-11 REGARDING EMPLOYMENT BENEFITS AND SALARY RATES FOR ALL CLASSES OF EMPLOYMENT, AND SUPERSEDING RESOLUTION NO. 23-21 - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 25-11 regarding employment benefits and salary rates for all classes of employment superseding Resolution No. 23-21.
9.2 Reso. No. 25-11
9.3
RESOLUTION NO. 25-12 REGARDING PAYING AND REPORTING THE VALUE OF EMPLOYER PAID MEMBER CONTRIBUTIONS TO THE CALIFORNIA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES' RETIREMENT SYSTEM - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 25-12 regarding paying and reporting the value of employer paid member contributions to the California Public Employees' Retirement System.
9.3 Reso. No. 25-12
9.4
RESOLUTION NO. 25-13 LOS ANGELES GATEWAY REGION INTEGRATED REGIONAL WATER MANAGEMENT AUTHORITY "GWMA" - AMENDED AND RESTATED JOINT EXERCISE OF POWER AUTHORITY AGREEMENT - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 25-13 approving the Amended and Restated Joint Exercise of Powers Authority Agreement, as presented and authorize the City Manager to execute the Amended and Restated Joint Exercise of Powers Authority Agreement.
9.4 Reso. No. 25-13
9.5
RESOLUTION NO. 25-14 APPROVING PARTICIPATION IN THE PERMANENT LOCAL HOUSING ALLOCATION PROGRAM - ACCESSIBILITY MODIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 25-14 approving the City's participation in the Los Angeles Urban County Permanent Local Housing Allocation Program and authorize the City Manager to execute a contract for funding and any additional documents required by LACDA.
9.5 Reso. No. 25-14
10.
